karty.priklad: Rhaid i fi gydio'n dynn yn fy ffon i gerdded.
karty.priklad_cs: I have to hold on tight to my stick to walk (cydio → [g]ydio after i fi; tynn → [d]ynn after yn).
karty.mnemo: A KID (CYD-io) grips your hand and holds on tight.

extra.pozn: pattern cydio yn + object; the preposition yn causes nasal mutation (cydio ym mraich); sentence from the dialogue (p. 96)

sever.priklad: Rhaid i mi gydio'n dynn yn fy ffon i gerdded.
sever.priklad_cs: I have to hold on tight to my stick to walk.
sever.pozn: north: i mi instead of i fi (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Esgusodwch fi, dw i'n ceisio dod o hyd i'r ysbyty.
karty.priklad_cs: Excuse me, I'm trying to find the hospital.

extra.kmen: irregular (dod): des i o hyd i…, dewch o hyd i…
extra.pozn: soft mutation after i (dod o hyd i Gaerdydd); synonyms ffeindio, cael hyd i (L12); sentence from the dialogue (p. 96)

karty.priklad: Mae'r caws 'ma'n drewi!
karty.priklad_cs: This cheese stinks!
karty.mnemo: ANDREW'S (an-DREW-I) old football socks stink the whole house out.

extra.pozn: drewllyd = smelly; own example

karty.cs: to press, to squeeze, to squash
karty.priklad: Gwasgwch y botwm i gael coffi.
karty.priklad_cs: Press the button to get a coffee (cael → [g]ael after i).
karty.mnemo: gwasg = press: gwasgu = to press, to squeeze.

extra.pozn: based on the video at the coffee machine (p. 94); gwasg (L15) = a press, printing press; waist

karty.priklad: Pwy sy'n sefyll ar bwys Dafydd? – Mae Efa'n sefyll ar ei bwys e.
karty.priklad_cs: Who's standing next to Dafydd? – Efa is standing next to him (pwys → [b]wys after ar).
karty.mnemo: Stand still and SAVE (SEF-yll) your energy.

extra.pozn: sefyll arholiad = to sit an exam; colloquially also sefes i; sentence from the drill (p. 93)

karty.priklad: Cyn rhedeg, dw i wastad yn ymestyn fy nghoesau.
karty.priklad_cs: Before running I always stretch my legs (coesau → [ngh]oesau after fy).
karty.mnemo: estyn = to reach, to stretch (as in estyniad, extension): ym- + estyn = to stretch yourself.

extra.pozn: Adolygu ac Ymestyn (name of the revision units) = revising and extending; own example

karty.priklad: Ysgydwch y botel laeth cyn ei hagor.
karty.priklad_cs: Shake the milk bottle before opening it (potel → [b]otel after y; llaeth → [l]aeth after the feminine potel).
karty.mnemo: Shake the bottle well and it IS GOOD (YS-GWYD).

extra.pozn: ysgwyd llaw = to shake hands; in the south colloquially often siglo (L11); own example

sever.priklad: Ysgydwch y botel lefrith cyn ei hagor.
sever.priklad_cs: Shake the milk bottle before opening it (llefrith → [l]efrith).
sever.pozn: north: llefrith instead of llaeth (L8, Y De a'r Gogledd)

karty.priklad: Yn anffodus, dw i ddim yn gallu dweud yr un peth amdana i fy hun!
karty.priklad_cs: Unfortunately, I can't say the same about myself!
karty.mnemo: an- (un-) + ffodus (fortunate).

extra.pozn: yn anffodus = unfortunately; sentence from the letter (p. 101)

sever.priklad: Yn anffodus, dw i ddim yn medru deud yr un peth amdana i fy hun!
sever.priklad_cs: Unfortunately, I can't say the same about myself!
sever.pozn: north: medru instead of gallu (L7), deud instead of dweud (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Hoffwn i ystafell ddwbl, os gwelwch yn dda.
karty.priklad_cs: I'd like a double room, please (dwbl → [dd]wbl after the feminine ystafell).
karty.mnemo: From English DOUBLE.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Does dim rhaid i'r car fod yn ddwyieithog!
karty.priklad_cs: The car doesn't have to be bilingual! (dwyieithog → [dd]wyieithog after yn; bod → [f]od after i)
karty.mnemo: dwy (two) + iaith (language) + -og.

extra.pozn: sentence from p. 94

karty.priklad: Mae'r grefi'n rhy hallt.
karty.priklad_cs: The gravy is too salty.
karty.mnemo: HALT! Stop eating – it's far too salty!

extra.pozn: halen = salt; dŵr hallt = salt water; own example

karty.priklad: Am beth od!
karty.priklad_cs: What an odd thing! (peth → [b]eth after the exclamatory am)
karty.mnemo: Same as English ODD.

extra.pozn: rhyfedd (L3) = synonym; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r jîns 'ma'n rhy dynn.
karty.priklad_cs: These jeans are too tight (tynn → [d]ynn after rhy).
karty.mnemo: A lid on a TIN (TYNN) so tight you can't open it.

extra.pozn: the coursebook writes tyn(n); yn dynn = tightly, firmly (gafael yn dynn); own example

karty.priklad: Mae apwyntiad gyda fi yn yr adran cleifion allanol am dri o'r gloch.
karty.priklad_cs: I've got an appointment in the outpatients' department at three o'clock.
karty.mnemo: adran (department) + cleifion (patients) + allanol (outer): the department for patients from outside, behind a bright red door.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the arall box; feminine, like adran; pl. adrannau cleifion allanol (outside the coursebook); sentence from the dialogue (p. 96)

sever.priklad: Mae gen i apwyntiad yn yr adran cleifion allanol am dri o'r gloch.
sever.priklad_cs: I've got an appointment in the outpatients' department at three o'clock.
sever.pozn: north: Mae gen i instead of Mae … gyda fi (L6)

karty.priklad: Ro'n i'n byw yn Abertawe ar y pryd.
karty.priklad_cs: I was living in Swansea at the time.
karty.mnemo: pryd = time (Pryd? = When?).

extra.pozn: cyfieithu ar y pryd = simultaneous interpreting; own example

karty.priklad: Er ei bod hi'n bwrw glaw, aethon ni am dro.
karty.priklad_cs: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
karty.mnemo: ER… although I'm tired, er, I'll still go.

extra.pozn: er + a bod clause (er fy mod i…, er ei fod e…); er + a time = since (er 1990); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi wastad yn hwyr.
karty.priklad_cs: She's always late.
karty.mnemo: gwastad = flat, level: life on the flat is always the same – wastad = always.

extra.pozn: from (yn) wastad, the mutation is fixed; synonym bob amser; own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n hoffi bwyd sbeislyd, yn enwedig cyri.
karty.priklad_cs: I like spicy food, especially curry.
karty.mnemo: I love cake, especially at ANY WEDDING (EN-WED-ig).

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n edrych ymlaen at glywed oddi wrthoch chi'n fuan.
karty.priklad_cs: I look forward to hearing from you soon (buan → [f]uan after yn; clywed → [g]lywed after at).
karty.mnemo: 'BE ON (BU-AN) time – see you soon!'

extra.pozn: end of a letter (p. 100)

karty.priklad: Roedd hi'n gafael yn dynn yn yr ysgol.
karty.priklad_cs: She was holding on tight to the ladder (tynn → [d]ynn after yn).
karty.mnemo: gafael (to grip) + yn dynn (tight; tynn → dynn after yn).

extra.pozn: phrase from Robin Radio (p. 100); gafael = cydio

karty.priklad: Cwympodd yr ysgol ar fy mhen i.
karty.priklad_cs: The ladder fell on my head (pen → [mh]en after fy).
karty.mnemo: pen = head, top; ar ben = on the head, on top.

extra.tvary: ar fy mhen i, ar dy ben di, ar ei ben e, ar ei phen hi
extra.pozn: declined the same way as ar bwys (Help llaw p. 102); ar ben fy hun = on my own; phrase from Robin Radio (p. 100), the sentence is my own

sever.priklad: Syrthiodd yr ysgol ar fy mhen i.
sever.priklad_cs: The ladder fell on my head.

karty.priklad: Collais i'r bws, ac i wneud pethau'n waeth, dechreuodd hi fwrw glaw.
karty.priklad_cs: I missed the bus, and to make things worse, it started to rain (gwaeth → [w]aeth after yn; bwrw → [f]wrw).

extra.pozn: phrase from Robin Radio (p. 100); gwaeth = worse (drwg → gwaeth)
